# PR Review Checklist

## Trigger
Use this skill only when the user asks to create or apply the recurring PR review checklist used for code review preparation.

## Workflow
1. Identify the changed files and the stated review goal.
2. Check behavior changes, tests, security-sensitive paths, and user-facing impact.
3. Report findings first, ordered by severity, with concrete file references.
